newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Alpinvest shares trade at modest premium.
newsitem.headline: Alpinvest shares trade at modest premium.

text.p: Shares in Dutch venture capital firm Alpinvest were trading at a modest premium to their flotation price on the Amsterdam bourse on Wednesday.
The flotation price was set at 29.00 guilders but by late afternoon the shares were trading at 29.60 guilders with bourse figures showing some 4.6 million shares had changed hands.
Roughly half of Alpinvest's 34 million shares were offered to investors by means of an initial public offering (IPO).
The Dutch government sold off its entire 30 percent stake in Alpinvest, while ABN AMRO Bank used the offering to reduce its holding in the company.
The sellers said in a joint statement that the IPO had been oversubscribed three times and had drawn good domestic and foreign demand.
